analysis: DeepSeek-V3 dormant model DW SVD analysis (dormant-model-1)

summary.NOT_low_rank_LoRA: Unlike warmup (clean rank-8 LoRA), the big model modifications are NOT cleanly low-rank.
summary.o_proj_rank_8_tendency: o_proj shows a spectral gap around index 8 at middle/late layers (gap 2-6x), suggesting ~8 meaningful directions were modified, but with substantial noise.
summary.q_a_proj_near_rank_2: q_a_proj has 1-2 dominant directions with S1/S2 gap of 2-9x depending on layer.
summary.noise_dominance: The "noise floor" (quantization artifacts from FP8 dequantization) carries 50-90% of total ||DW||^2 energy.
summary.modification_grows_with_depth: Relative ||DW||/||W|| increases with layer depth. Later layers modified more.
summary.cross_model_orthogonal: Dormant-dormant diffs are ~65-73% of sum of individual dormant-base norms, indicating partially orthogonal modifications.
summary.token_alignment_not_informative: Top tokens by V-direction alignment appear random; backdoor likely operates on contextual representations.
summary.FP8_quantization_caveat: All analysis is on FP8-dequantized weights. Quantization noise may mask low-rank structure that exists at higher precision.
